Jenna (People Ops): Quick check 7 Release freeze next week (Aug 2-6). Some folks asked about booking PTO during freeze. Policy?
Omar (Release Lead): We prefer folks avoid taking core freeze days if they're on release rotations, but we don't hard-block PTO. Request managers to coordinate coverage.
Claire (IC): I'm on the release checklist owner list. If I take a day, do I lose on-call credit or can we swap?
Omar (Release Lead): Swap within team first. If no swap, reach out here and we'll assign a temporary owner. No automatic penalty.
Jenna (People Ops): Process we recommend: 1) try a peer swap; 2) update the release rota doc; 3) manager approves PTO with a note "release-coverage" if swapped; 4) if coverage gap remains tag `coverage-needed`.
Dan (Payroll): If you work during a company-declared freeze (i.e., required coverage), you can request a comp day. Submit via payroll within 10 days.
Claire (IC): Can HRbot surface a tooltip when people request PTO that overlaps Aug 2-6?
HRbot: Suggested: show soft warning "Overlaps release freeze window. Coordinate with release lead and manager." Enable for repo-release team?
Jenna (People Ops): Yes please enable for repo-release and infra teams. Also we'll add a short paragraph to the PTO FAQ.
Omar (Release Lead): Thanks. I'll post the team coverage table by EOD and ping folks to swap where needed.
Claire (IC): Nice, thanks all.
